text:
Mia R: quick question — saved-query UX: if a user saves a view scoped to a route but adds a model filter, should the per-route view surface model toggles or treat model filters as opaque criteria? cc @Jordan
Jordan: i'd avoid adding model toggles in the main per-route list. too much noise. but we could show a small "active model filters" pill that opens a modal. keeps the route-first mental model. :thinking:
Samir: from infra perspective if UI exposes model toggles we need routing hints in the saved-query payload so the router can pick compatible variants and cost-preview can work. that means API changes.
Peggy: users often want to quickly see "route + model" breakdowns. proposal: keep saved-query scope as route, but allow optional model-filters that are applied at render time and annotated in the UI with a cost preview CTA.
Mia R: two edgecases: 1) saved query with model filter saved on route A, then route A later gets model B removed — should the saved query still surface? 2) does saving with a model-filter lock the query to a specific model version? feels risky.
Samir: implementation plan idea: extend saved query schema with an optional `model_affinity` field. backward compatible, optional. sample payload: ```json
{
  "scope": "route",
  "route_id": "route_42",
  "filters": { "status": "error" },
  "model_affinity": ["redwood/xl-v1", "redwood/xl-v1-8bit"],
  "routing_hints": { "prefer": "low_cost" }
}
```
Samir: router will treat `model_affinity` as a soft preference; if none available we fall back to default route model set. this avoids hard failing saved queries.
Adele: design note: show a tiny tag next to saved-view name: `models: 2` with tooltip: "Model filters affect routing and may change cost/latency". tooltip copy draft: "This saved view filters results by model. Applying it may change routing decisions and cost estimates."
Peggy: UX detail — add an explicit "Apply model filters (preview cost)" button in the modal so users opt into cost-impacting routing. reduces surprise. :+1:
Jordan: let's gate behind a feature flag and do a 10% experiment. collect telemetry: `saved_query_applied`, `model_preview_clicked`, `routing_override_count`, `cost_preview_shown`.
Mia R: Samir can you confirm API names and whether quota calc runs when previewing? we need to avoid double-charging quotas during previews.
Samir: confirmed — preview will call the cost-estimate endpoint (no quota debit). will add `model_affinity` to "/v1/queries/save" and "/v1/queries/fetch" responses. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234 (draft).
deploy-bot: feature-toggle console.savedquery.model_filter scheduled: canary rollout 2024-11-02T03:00Z -> 10% -> 100% if no regressions.
Peggy: i'll update release notes + docs. Adele i'll ping you for final tooltip copy.
Adele: thanks — will add microcopy and a small mock in Figma by EOD tomorrow.
Jordan: ok i'll own the experiment dashboard (metrics above). Mia — can you create the ask for analytics sampling config?
Mia R: will do, creating a quick ticket now and tagging infra/analytics. ty everyone.
